summary: Frontend-only test of new Stays page filter additions (Bathrooms, Porches/Balcony, Property condition, Features: Furnished+Elevator). All 8 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end against the public preview URL.

issues: Minor duplication: the Amenities row still contains an 'Elevator' chip while there is now a dedicated Features > Elevator toggle. The two filter against different fields (amenities[] string match vs p.has_elevator boolean), which may surprise users. Consider removing 'Elevator' (and possibly 'Balcony') from ALL_AMENITIES to avoid two competing filters for the same concept.

test_results.modal_renders_all_sections_in_order: PASS — order: Stay type, Price range, Bedrooms, Bathrooms, Porches/Balcony, Property condition, Features, Amenities (Dates section is sm:hidden on desktop, by design)
test_results.bathrooms_chip_group: PASS — Any/1+/2+/3+ all present; selecting 2+ writes ?bathrooms=2
test_results.condition_chip_group: PASS — Any/Renovated/Partially Renovated/Good Condition present; selecting Renovated writes ?condition=renovated
test_results.features_toggles: PASS — Furnished + Elevator pills toggle to gold-on-black active state; write ?furnished=1 / ?elevator=1
test_results.filter_badge_count: PASS — selecting bathrooms 2+, porches 1+, condition renovated, furnished, elevator → badge reads 5
test_results.clear_all: PASS — stays-filters-clear deselects every new chip, removes the badge, and strips all 5 URL params
test_results.url_hydration: PASS — direct visit to /stays?bathrooms=2&porches=1&condition=renovated&furnished=1&elevator=1 opens the modal with all 5 chips already in active state and badge=5

action_items: (Optional UX) Remove duplicate 'Elevator' (and maybe 'Balcony') from ALL_AMENITIES list now that they live in the Features section, to avoid two filters competing for the same property attribute.
critical_code_review_comments: Stays.jsx is now 872 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Filters modal (~230 lines) could be extracted into its own file (e.g. components/stays/FiltersModal.jsx) for maintainability.
ChipRow helper is correctly hoisted outside FiltersModal so React preserves chip identity between renders — good fix.
activeFilterCount and isSearchActive both list the same filter set; consider deriving one from the other to avoid drift when adding the next filter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stays filters now include 5 new persisted filters (bathrooms, porches, condition, furnished, elevator). All URL params and chip active-states verified working. Note the cosmetic overlap between Features.Elevator and Amenities.Elevator — not breaking, just a UX nit.
